      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Complaint_Send" sourceRef="Start_StockZero" targetRef="Task_EmailFriends"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Complaint_End" sourceRef="Task_EmailFriends" targetRef="End_Complaint"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_CreateList" sourceRef="Start_Contract" targetRef="Task_CreatePartsList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CreateList_Query" sourceRef="Task_CreatePartsList" targetRef="Task_QueryShops"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Query_Offers" sourceRef="Task_QueryShops" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Offers_Compare" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOffers" targetRef="Task_CompareOffers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Compare_Select" sourceRef="Task_CompareOffers" targetRef="Task_SelectCheapest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Select_Decision" sourceRef="Task_SelectCheapest" targetRef="Gateway_SupplyDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Decision_OneShop" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_SupplyDecision" targetRef="Task_ListOneShop">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">oneShopCanSupplyRequiredQuantity</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Decision_SeveralShops" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_SupplyDecision" targetRef="Task_ListSeveralShops">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not oneShopCanSupplyRequiredQuantity</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OneShop_Merge" sourceRef="Task_ListOneShop" targetRef="Gateway_OrderListMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SeveralShops_Merge" sourceRef="Task_ListSeveralShops" targetRef="Gateway_OrderListMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Merge_SendOrders" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderListMerge" targetRef="Task_SendInitialOrders"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendOrders_FirstParts" sourceRef="Task_SendInitialOrders" targetRef="Event_FirstPartsArrive"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FirstParts_StartBuilding" sourceRef="Event_FirstPartsArrive" targetRef="Task_StartBuilding"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartBuilding_Build" sourceRef="Task_StartBuilding" targetRef="Task_BuildContract"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Build_End" sourceRef="Task_BuildContract" targetRef="End_BuildingScope"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_Contract"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/contract">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_QuoteRequest" name="Quote request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Offers" name="Shop offers"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PurchaseOrder" name="Parts order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PartsDelivery" name="Parts delivery"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Complaint" name="Complaint email"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Contract">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Project" name="Contract project" processRef="Process_Contract"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_WebShops" name="Web shops"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Friends" name="Friends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Query" name="Quote request" sourceRef="Task_QueryShops" targetRef="Participant_WebShops" messageRef="Message_QuoteRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Offers" name="Shop offers" sourceRef="Participant_WebShops" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffers" messageRef="Message_Offers"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_InitialOrder" name="Parts order" sourceRef="Task_SendInitialOrders" targetRef="Participant_WebShops" messageRef="Message_PurchaseOrder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FirstDelivery" name="Parts delivery" sourceRef="Participant_WebShops" targetRef="Event_FirstPartsArrive" messageRef="Message_PartsDelivery"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CheapReorder" name="Cheapest parts reorder" sourceRef="Task_SendCheapReorder" targetRef="Participant_WebShops" messageRef="Message_PurchaseOrder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FastReorder" name="Fastest parts reorder" sourceRef="Task_SendFastReorder" targetRef="Participant_WebShops" messageRef="Message_PurchaseOrder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Complaint" name="Complaint email" sourceRef="Task_EmailFriends" targetRef="Participant_Friends" messageRef="Message_Complaint"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Contract" name="Contract" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Contract" name="Contract project starts"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreatePartsList" name="Create list of required parts"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_QueryShops" name="Query all web shops" messageRef="Message_QuoteRequest"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveOffers" name="Receive quantities, prices, and delivery times" messageRef="Message_Offers"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompareOffers" name="Compare quantities, prices, and delivery times"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectCheapest" name="Select the cheapest parts"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SupplyDecision" name="Can one shop supply enough parts?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ListOneShop" name="Create parts list for one shop"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ListSeveralShops" name="Create parts lists for several shops"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OrderListMerge" name="Continue with order list"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendInitialOrders" name="Send parts orders to shops" messageRef="Message_PurchaseOrder"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_FirstPartsArrive" name="First parts arrive">
      <bpmn:documentation>Parts arrive in batches in a random order, typically about two days earlier or later than expected.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_FirstParts" messageRef="Message_PartsDelivery"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_StartBuilding" name="Start building"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_BuildContract" name="Build contract project"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_BuildingScope" name="Building finished"/>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_ReorderCheapest" name="Reorder cheapest parts when stock falls below 5" triggeredByEvent="true">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_StockBelow5" name="Stock of a single part falls below 5" isInterrupting="false">
        <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="Conditional_StockBelow5">
          <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">stockOfSinglePart < 5</bpmn:condition>
        </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectCheapestReorder" name="Select the cheapest parts to reorder"/>
      <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendCheapReorder" name="Send cheapest parts reorder" messageRef="Message_PurchaseOrder"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_CheapReorder" name="Cheapest reorder sent"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheapStart_Select" sourceRef="Start_StockBelow5" targetRef="Task_SelectCheapestReorder"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheapSelect_Send" sourceRef="Task_SelectCheapestReorder" targetRef="Task_SendCheapReorder"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheapSend_End" sourceRef="Task_SendCheapReorder" targetRef="End_CheapReorder"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_ReorderFastest" name="Reorder fastest parts when stock falls below 3" triggeredByEvent="true">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_StockBelow3" name="Stock of a single part falls below 3" isInterrupting="false">
        <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="Conditional_StockBelow3">
          <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">stockOfSinglePart < 3</bpmn:condition>
        </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectFastestReorder" name="Select the fastest parts to reorder"/>
      <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendFastReorder" name="Send fastest parts reorder" messageRef="Message_PurchaseOrder"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_FastReorder" name="Fastest reorder sent"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FastStart_Select" sourceRef="Start_StockBelow3" targetRef="Task_SelectFastestReorder"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FastSelect_Send" sourceRef="Task_SelectFastestReorder" targetRef="Task_SendFastReorder"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FastSend_End" sourceRef="Task_SendFastReorder" targetRef="End_FastReorder"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_ComplainAtZero" name="Complain when stock is zero" triggeredByEvent="true">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_StockZero" name="Stock of a single part is zero" isInterrupting="false">
        <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="Conditional_StockZero">
          <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">stockOfSinglePart = 0</bpmn:condition>
        </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_EmailFriends" name="Email friends to complain about the web shops" messageRef="Message_Complaint"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Complaint" name="Complaint email sent"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Complaint_Send" sourceRef="Start_StockZero" targetRef="Task_EmailFriends"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Complaint_End" sourceRef="Task_EmailFriends" targetRef="End_Complaint"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_CreateList" sourceRef="Start_Contract" targetRef="Task_CreatePartsList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CreateList_Query" sourceRef="Task_CreatePartsList" targetRef="Task_QueryShops"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Query_Offers" sourceRef="Task_QueryShops" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Offers_Compare" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOffers" targetRef="Task_CompareOffers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Compare_Select" sourceRef="Task_CompareOffers" targetRef="Task_SelectCheapest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Select_Decision" sourceRef="Task_SelectCheapest" targetRef="Gateway_SupplyDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Decision_OneShop" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_SupplyDecision" targetRef="Task_ListOneShop">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">oneShopCanSupplyRequiredQuantity</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Decision_SeveralShops" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_SupplyDecision" targetRef="Task_ListSeveralShops">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not oneShopCanSupplyRequiredQuantity</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OneShop_Merge" sourceRef="Task_ListOneShop" targetRef="Gateway_OrderListMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SeveralShops_Merge" sourceRef="Task_ListSeveralShops" targetRef="Gateway_OrderListMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Merge_SendOrders" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderListMerge" targetRef="Task_SendInitialOrders"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendOrders_FirstParts" sourceRef="Task_SendInitialOrders" targetRef="Event_FirstPartsArrive"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FirstParts_StartBuilding" sourceRef="Event_FirstPartsArrive" targetRef="Task_StartBuilding"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartBuilding_Build" sourceRef="Task_StartBuilding" targetRef="Task_BuildContract"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Build_End" sourceRef="Task_BuildContract" targetRef="End_BuildingScope"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

rules.instruction: When the description says that work begins when a specified event occurs: Model the specified event as a trigger in the continuing flow and the described work as an activity after it, not as an end event.
rules.situation: the description says that work begins when a specified event occurs

rules.instruction: When the description names a distinct activity or outcome and states its action or completion condition: Label the corresponding BPMN element with the described action or outcome. Do not replace it with a broader or narrower action, or add detail the description does not support.
rules.situation: the description states an activity or decision with a specific action, object, criterion, or outcome

rules.instruction: When the description makes an action conditional on whether a stated condition holds: Model the condition as a control-flow decision with alternative outgoing paths, so the action is taken only on the applicable path; do not use a gateway with only one incoming and one outgoing sequence flow.
rules.situation: the description states that whether a source can satisfy a required quantity determines whether the items are obtained from one source or multiple sources

rules.instruction: When the description states an activity or outcome and identifies its action, object, actor, or recipient: label the corresponding BPMN element with concise wording that preserves those stated details and does not substitute a different action or meaning
rules.situation: the description states an activity, decision, or outcome and identifies its action or meaning

rules.instruction: Use an exclusive split when exactly one data-based alternative runs. Add supported conditions and at most one default fallback.
rules.situation: the description states that a requirement may be met by one source or may require multiple sources

rules.instruction: When the description states that a participant requests or orders goods and separately states that the goods are delivered or received: Model the request or order and the receipt as distinct flow elements; represent receipt as a receiving activity or an appropriate catching event, not as another activity that sends an order.
rules.situation: the description states that a participant requests or orders goods and separately states that the goods are delivered or received
